notes: PHASE 8 (OBLIVION-PLAN section 8.2): the things a docker USES. Read after items.json and appended to its rows, because items.json is the owner's and is never edited; every id here comes after every id there.
Same columns as items.json, plus use: {verb, done, effects}. verb is the key's word (EAT), done the message line's (ATE). A row with effects is a consumable: one unit is spent by every use.

effects speak the spells' own integer vocabulary and nothing else. vitality: a signed hit-point change, instant, a mend when positive. attribute: a held tuning (param MGT AGI VIG WIT, the spells' tokens), seconds of room time, clamped with every other live hold to +/-2.
No hunger and no thirst (ruling 12 of OBLIVION-PLAN): none of these is a need. They mend, or they steady a hand; a body that does not eat loses nothing.
There is no lantern-oil row: nothing in the ward burns a held lantern's fuel yet, so a flask would be a row whose use did nothing.
stands put a thing on a tile before anybody moves it; owned means taking it is theft (THEIRS on the crosshair, and in the pack).
Provenance: no canon row names these. Loaf, mug and linen are the quayside's plainest goods; the weights and worths are in items.json's own scale (a bottle is 5 drams and 1 royal).
